containment_test: Every child vertex satisfies every parent convex-hull halfspace, in physical [vc,r,phi] coordinates.

broad_phase.proof: Every candidate vertex is an original stable grid node. Every convex combination of those nodes lies within the coordinatewise global stable-node bounds. Nodes strictly beyond those bounds plus the 1e-8 margin cannot belong to any candidate convex hull. Final selected hull is additionally audited against every raw unstable node.

unpruned_accelerated_crosscheck.purpose: Compare final exact-source Octave result with independent unpruned accelerated original algorithm
